additional_sources.title: DESNZ: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 1990 to 2024
additional_sources.guard: Accredited Official Statistics provide final 2024 UK territorial GHG totals by gas and sector. National totals are context only and cannot be attributed to an installation or parcel.

additional_sources.title: DESNZ: Annual statement of emissions for 2024
additional_sources.guard: Statutory annual statement independently cross-checks 2024 UK territorial GHG totals used in S1152. Duplicate national totals are not promoted as additional candidate measurements.

additional_sources.title: ONS: Greenhouse gas emissions UK provisional estimates 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official ONS environmental accounts provide residence-basis 2024 UK and industry emissions. Residence-basis totals are methodologically distinct from territorial or installation emissions and remain context.

additional_sources.title: DESNZ: 2005 to 2024 UK local and regional greenhouse gas emissions
additional_sources.guard: Official local-authority/regional statistics strengthen spatial aggregate context. Local-authority totals are not cadastral parcels and cannot be assigned to a specific installation without direct binding evidence.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Rugby Cement Plant environmental permit EPR/BL7248IH/V016
additional_sources.guard: Environment Agency permit identifies Cemex UK Cement Limited, Rugby Cement Plant, Rugby, CV21 2RY and permit EPR/BL7248IH/V016. Binding/identity evidence only; no observed 2024 GHG quantity is implied.

additional_sources.title: CEMEX UK: Rugby Cement Plant one million tonnes alternative fuel milestone
additional_sources.guard: Official operator release states one million tonnes of alternative fuel used and more than 750,000 tonnes of coal consumption reduced at Rugby. These are resource/abatement context, not observed annual GHG emissions.

additional_sources.title: Animal and Plant Health Agency annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
additional_sources.guard: Official government annual report contains explicit organisation-level Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3, total and building-direct emissions. Organisation totals are context only and cannot be attributed to individual APHA sites or parcels.

additional_sources.title: Palm Gruppe: Palm invests 80 million pounds at Kings Lynn Paper Mill
additional_sources.guard: Official operator page states the Kings Lynn CHP investment reduces annual CO2 emissions by 80,000 tonnes per year. This is an abatement/reduction claim, not the mill's observed annual emissions; it cannot be converted into a facility total.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CONTEXT: National, residence-basis or organisation-level totals remain context unless a directly measured installation scope is explicit.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Regional/local-authority aggregates support spatial context only and cannot become parcels.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit/address/facility evidence strengthens identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Cross-checks, resource substitution and avoided/reduced emissions are provenance/context and cannot substitute for observed installation emissions.

web_research_basis: Fresh public internet research on 2026-07-27 using DESNZ, ONS, Environment Agency/GOV.UK and official operator sources. Exact 2024 national and organisation figures are isolated as context; Rugby permit strengthens onshore installation binding; CEMEX/Palm abatement figures are not treated as observed emissions. No inaccessible UK ETS/HSE workbook value is guessed or retried repeatedly.
